The public API producer walks triangles, normals, prototype sharing, poses,
physical bounds and material properties. It records authored asset stability.
Scientific correctness is held separately by the physical and source tests.
GPU pictures retain their existing numerical and image acceptance bounds.

From the module root, the retained producer is run with:
go run ./manufacture/testdata/geometry_sample.go
